Boston Breathes: Where campuses and stations are

Section D of the Boston Breathes figures: the campus zones used throughout the analysis, and the Bluebikes and MBTA stations in the study area, the 22 cities and towns of the Metropolitan Area Planning Council's Inner Core.

Bluebikes stations and campus zones

Which Bluebikes stations count as campus, near or away?

  • Shaded areas are within 400 m (campus) and 1 km (near) of a campus of a large institution (median fall in-person enrollment of 1,000 or more), clipped to the study area, whose towns are outlined; orange crosses are those campus points. Stations elsewhere in the study area are away.
  • 92 campus, 183 near and 403 away stations.
  • Bluebikes renumbered its stations in 2023; records within 10 m of each other (one station under its old and new IDs) are drawn and counted as one station. Stations are sized by average trips started per day between their first and last recorded day. Outside Boston, Cambridge, Somerville and Brookline, Bluebikes opened in 2019–2022, apart from one employer station in Quincy.
